## Seedspitter (CR 2)

**XP** 600  
N Medium plant  
**Init** +3; **Senses** blindsight 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +0  


**Defense**


**AC** 15, touch 13, flat-footed 15 (+3 Dex, +2 natural)  
**hp** 19 (3d8+6)  
**Fort** +5; **Ref** +4; **Will** +1  
**DR** 5/slashing; **Immune** plant traits; **Resist** fire 10  
**Weaknesses** vulnerable to cold  


**Offense**


**Speed** 5 ft.  
**Melee** slam +4 (1d4+3)  
**Ranged** seed spit +5 (1d6+2 plus poison)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 15, **Dex** 16, **Con** 14, Int —, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 9  
**Base Atk** +2; **CMB** +4; **CMD** 17  


**Special Abilities**


**Poison (Ex)** Seed spit—injury; save Fort DC 13; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d2 Con damage; cure 1 save.  

**Seed Spit (Ex)** A seedspitter can spit out a seed at high velocity as a ranged attack with a range increment of 20 ft. and a maximum range of 100 feet, dealing bludgeoning and piercing damage.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** temperate or warm forests or plains  
**Organization** solitary, group (2-5), or grove (6-18)  
**Treasure** incidental
